title: Wanting out of the Nazarro contract; dating Pathe
summary: At Pathe he resolved to break the management contract and tries to fix the year as 1921 or 1922.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it

blocks.x: Oh, there's another scene that I forgot to give you and that scene is when we were at the Pathe' studio I decided I wanted to break the contract, I wanted to get out from under the contract. After I found these different things happening with Nazarro, I wanted to get out of that contract, you know.
What did the contract obligate you to do? What were you obligated to do?
No, no, no. To get out of the contract with the management -- that's what we're talking about, the management

now. So what I did was -- oh, there's another thing now -- I should think to vitalize this, to take this to a more systematic situation is we leave the Riverside Theater -- you got that. That other part comes in another place I see -- We go back to New York. During this time I think is when Chuck and Chuckles came to New York - 1921 -- you passed 192 -- Pathe' studio was in 1922, wasn't it, or was it '21 -- '22, wasn't it?
I think it was '22. Pathe' studio, wasn't it or was it '21, 22 wasn't it?
